{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' and my Nikto brother is simply ''Drok''.|Te Corso|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
'''Drok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], Drok was present at the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] visited it in [[137 ABY]], seeking to gain the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council's]] help in [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] [[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his faction]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Empire. The Council refused, instead opting to oppose Krayt by allying with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile|forces]]. Drok, along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters [[Asaak Dan]], [[Sayar Dun'La]], and [[Te Corso]], was sent by the Council to meet with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], the leader of the Galactic Alliance Remnant in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. Shortly after Drok and the other Jedi boarded Stazi's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] was [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|assaulted]] by Sith forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Masters Dun'La, Te Corso, Drok&mdash;stick with Cade and me. Cover Master Saa until she's ready.|Bantha Rawk during the Attack on the Hidden Temple|<ref name="Legacy War 4" />}}
Following the death of [[Darth Krayt]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Legacy 42" /> [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]]<ref name=" Species" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Drok&mdash;alongside fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Asaak Dan]], [[Sayar Dun'La]] and [[Te Corso]]&mdash;was sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to aid the anti-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alliance formed by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]]. Arriving at [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], the flagship of Alliance's leader [[Gar Stazi]], the Jedi greeted Stazi and began discussing the possibilities of joint operations.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

However, the meeting was interrupted by an [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|attack]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[First Coruscant Task Force]] as well as an assassination attempt on Admiral Stazi. After disabling the would-be assassin, Shipman [[Tealart]], Drok and Master Corso boarded their [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]]s, joined the battle, and helped hold the Imperial attackers off enough for the fleet to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to their next rendezvous point.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

Later, during the [[Evacuation of Dac]], Drok was a member of [[Sword Squadron (Jedi)|Sword Squadron]]. The Jedi Master led a taskforce in sabotaging the defenses of the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Also capturing ships present there, Drok's success allowed the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] to push back the remaining Imperials and for the rescue operation to begin.<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>

In [[138 ABY]], Drok was again at the [[Hidden Temple]] during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|battle]] with the Sith. Alongside Masters Dun'la and Corso, Drok was killed defending [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]].<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DeathofDrok.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Drok's corpse lays among the fallen.]]
Drok was written by by [[John Ostrander]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] first appeared on the cover for [[Legacy (2006) 26|issue twenty-six]], part two of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: The Hidden Temple|''The Hidden Temple'']] story arc; the cover art was by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref> Because of a surplus of characters in the story, Drok and the other three Jedi from the cover of ''Legacy 26'' were not used in the actual comic itself. Originally, they were to accompany Cade Skywalker against the wishes of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] in his hunt for [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28816293|board=Literature|thread=Legacy #26: The Hidden Temple, part 2 (of 2)|user=[[John Ostrander|jfostrander01]]|date=2008-07-23|time=8:46 am|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304152321/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/legacy-26-the-hidden-temple-part-2-of-2.28287244/page-4}}</ref>

Drok was first identified and featured more prominently in [[Legacy (2006) 42|''Divided Loyalties'']], the series' forty-second issue, which was drawn by [[Dave Ross]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Drok later received appearances in [[Legacy (2006) 47|''The Fate of Dac'']]&mdash;the series' forty-seventh issue<ref name="Legacy 47" />&mdash;and the [[Legacy — War 4|fourth issue]] of [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']], the follow-up miniseries to ''Legacy''.<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> In these two issues, Drok was penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 47" /><ref name="Legacy War 4" />

In the cover art of ''Divided Loyalties'', Drok wields a purple-bladed lightsaber. However, in the actual comic, he wields a yellow-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> In issue 47, he carries a blue lightsaber,<ref name="Legacy 42" /> while in ''Legacy—War'' 4, his blade changes color once more to green.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />
